newsitem.title: USA: Softdesk says Q3 oper income to be hurt.
newsitem.headline: Softdesk says Q3 oper income to be hurt.

text.p: Softdesk Inc said on Thursday it expects its third quarter operating earnings to be hurt by a continued softness in the AutoCAD software market.
The company said it anticipates its revenues for the third quarter of 1996 to be below management's projections and about $1 million to $1.25 million below analysts' estimates.
The company was not immediately available for specific figures, but analysts had expected the company to earn $0.11 a share, according to First Call.
In last year's third quarter, the company posted earnings of $0.24 a share.
Softdesk said many customers delaying purchases of our software as they invest in their internal transition from DOS to Windows and its European markets are weak.

However, during the third quarter we also saw a strengthening of our business generated in our Retail Products Group and released several new products including CAD Overlay 7.5 and Planix Home Design Suite, the company said.
